name: surtr-language
description: Language support for the Surtr embedded scripting language: syntax highlighting, hover, go-to-definition and diagnostics

surtr.languageServer.path.description: Path to the surtr-lsp executable (surtr-lsp.exe on Windows). A directory containing the executable also works. Leave empty to look for surtr-lsp on your PATH.

surtr.projectRoot.description: Where the Surtr project actually starts, if it is not the folder you opened in VSCode - for example a subdirectory of a larger repo. Relative paths resolve against the opened folder. Leave empty to use the opened folder itself.
